description: Unit tests for the AV1Decoder class in the media GPU module, testing decoding functionality, error handling, configuration changes, and reference frame management.

classes.name: FakeAV1Picture
classes.description: A mock subclass of AV1Picture used in tests to simulate picture creation and duplication.

classes.name: MockAV1Accelerator
classes.description: A mock implementation of the AV1Decoder::AV1Accelerator interface for testing.

classes.name: AV1DecoderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing the AV1Decoder, providing setup, utility functions, and test cases.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the AV1Decoder with a mock accelerator before each test.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Feeds a DecoderBuffer into the decoder and returns the sequence of decode results.

methods.name: GetDecoderState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the libgav1 decoder.

methods.name: GetReferenceFrames
methods.description: Returns the reference frame vector tracked by the decoder.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder state while preserving stream parameters.

methods.name: ReadDecoderBuffer
methods.description: Reads a test file into a DecoderBuffer.

methods.description: Reads IVF format video data into a vector of DecoderBuffers.

methods.name: ReadWebm
methods.description: Reads WebM format video data into a vector of DecoderBuffers.
